subject.title: fix(heartbeat): bound HEARTBEAT.md file read size

question: Should heartbeat preflight intentionally stop accepting symlinked HEARTBEAT.md files as part of this bounded-read fix?
rationale: Bounding the input is clearly warranted, but repository code and documentation do not establish regular-file-only handling as the existing workspace contract, so silently changing that behavior requires owner intent.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Use a bounded read that retains current fs.readFile-compatible file acceptance and add regression coverage for both oversized and symlinked files.

options.title: Adopt regular-file-only
options.body: Keep readRegularFile, explicitly approve symlink rejection, and add a focused test documenting that symlinked heartbeat files are intentionally ignored.

recommendation.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
recommendation.body: Use a bounded read that retains current fs.readFile-compatible file acceptance and add regression coverage for both oversized and symlinked files.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent merged work owns the current preflight implementation and its missing/read-error continuation behavior.
